args.title: Old Ledger
args.pages: Day 12. The fort holds. Three boars in the larder, two logs short of a roof. Mind the east gate, the hinge is loose and the wind has been testing it all week.|Day 13. Raven says the storm comes at dusk. Moved the forge inside and covered the charcoal. Tomorrow we dig for tin, if the ground allows.|Day 14. Quiet.|
